PS. Are You A Parent?
Are you thinking about Homeschooling for your kids?
My wife and I have homeschooled our two boys.
Looking back, it’s one of the BEST decisions we’ve ever made.
It gave us the space to pass on our values.
It also gave them space to explore their passions and interests.
If you want to know more about homeschooling and to find out if it is for your kids, check out this link: www.facebook.com/CFAHomeschool or cfa.edu.ph

comments.text: Financial struggles me and my husband  are facing right now...

comments.author: @RATheBlueWolf2021
comments.text: Lord, help me to stand up again amidst every problem. Heal me, save me, and prevent me from saying "I CAN'T TAKE IT ANYMORE." instead I will be saying "I CAN DO ANYTHING THROUGH CHRIST WHO STRENGTHENS ME."  I pray this in Jesus' name, Amen.

comments.author: @pamyvilla
comments.text: This message is spot on for me. I love this part - Victory is not just about reaching the finish line first but also refusing to stay down and getting up again & again. It’s about my finances. Struggling and limping now but at least going forward & upward. Still facing failure & rejections but I will never go low and will stay high no matter the struggle

comments.author: @win.elnasinSoad25
comments.text: Maybe God still wants me to dream and believe in myself, even when my mind tells me it’s already too late. To stand up for myself, because at the end of the day, no one in this world will always be there to help me. 😔
